title: Fourier norm of a low-degree part
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, $k$ a nonnegative integer, and $f$ a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The Fourier one-norm of the part of $f$ formed from Fourier terms indexed by subsets of size at most $k$ equals the sum of the absolute values of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ over those subsets.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
